name: line-oss-crm
description: Open-source LINE Official Account CRM/marketing automation

scripts.db:migrate: for f in packages/db/schema.sql packages/db/migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute line-crm -c apps/worker/wrangler.toml --remote --file="$f"; done
scripts.db:migrate:local: for f in packages/db/schema.sql packages/db/migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute line-crm -c apps/worker/wrangler.toml --local --file="$f"; done
